draft_notes.explanation: Identify hollow4x4frames, discard solid squares, and concatenate frames along a demonstrated spacing rule. Candidate rules: minimum adjacent projection gaps identify the separated axis (native rule), versus total row/column spread with both tie conventions. Fit every demonstration, then require all surviving query predictions to agree. No out-of-domain fallback or preferred native rule when evidence is ambiguous.
draft_notes.limitations: Native random domain has2or3hollowframes, distinct colours, separated4x4boxes and an unambiguous min-gap direction. Original benchmark agrees with both common rules; some queries need a discriminating generated demo. Three-hypothesis evidence check does not claim uniqueness among all ARC programs.
